comparisons.peer_summary: Intel enters into government incentive arrangements structured as cash grants and refundable tax credits for qualifying capital investments, R&D, and activities, with terms up to 15 years for capital-related incentives and varied terms for operating-related incentives. These arrangements require compliance with conditions such as operational targets and minimum capital investment, with potential reduction, recapture, or termination if conditions are not satisfied.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and INTC disclose aggregate government incentive commitments and the conditions attached to receiving them. MU reports $3.4 billion in aggregate commitments through 2033, including specific projects in India and Japan, contingent on performance conditions. Similarly, INTC discloses entering into government incentive arrangements with local, regional, and national governments, noting that these arrangements vary in size and duration and require compliance with conditions, such as operational targets and minimum capital investment, with potential recapture or termination if not met. Both companies highlight that these incentives are tied to qualifying capital investments and R&D activities.

sentences.text: In addition to the receivables and other noncurrent assets in the table above, as of August 29, 2024, we had aggregate commitments from various governmental entities of up to $3.4 billion to be received through 2033, subject to achievement of certain performance conditions.
The commitment amount includes $1.8 billion (150 billion Indian rupees) for the construction of a new assembly and test facility in Gujarat, India.

The commitment amount also includes up to $1.3 billion (188 billion Japanese yen) from the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry to support the production of DRAM using EUV lithography in Hiroshima, Japan.
We enter into government incentive arrangements with local, regional, and national governments, both US and non-US.
These arrangements vary in size, duration, and conditions and allow us to maintain a market-comparable foothold across various geographies.
We are eligible to receive these incentives because we engage in qualifying capital investments, R&D, and other activities as defined by the relevant government entities.
Each incentive requires that we comply with certain conditions for a period that may exceed the incentive terms.
